dct_title_s: Soudan Mine, No. 8 Shaft, 22nd Level, West, Second Section, Soudan, Minnesota
dct_description_sm: A map of the 22nd level at the Soudan Mine continuing from where the first section of the map ended. The map shows the drifts, cross cuts, rock formations, raises, core sample drill holes, and stope areas. Lake Superior Datum.
